## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wǔmǔ zǐ jīng* (T555a) is the "a" recension of a one-fascicle short sūtra by Zhī Qiān 支謙 ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99)). The narrative concerns a son who in successive past lives had five different mothers, illustrating the karmic ties of family relations across rebirths.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna* exemplifying the doctrine of inter-life karmic family ties. Translation dated to Zhī Qiān's Wú productive period (222–252 CE).
